# BlockMiner

> Play-to-earn virtual mining on Polygon. Build farms, grow hashrate, complete offers and games, earn real POL (and SHIB) that you can withdraw on-chain.

BlockMiner is a web app at [https://blockminer.space](https://blockminer.space). Users install virtual miners in racks, earn from faucet / check-in / offerwalls / mini-games / tournaments, and manage POL + SHIB balances in a Web3 wallet flow (Polygon). Default product language is Portuguese (Brazil); Spanish and English are available.

## Primary

- [Home / landing](https://blockminer.space/): Product overview, how mining works, call to register
- [Register](https://blockminer.space/register): Create an account
- [Login](https://blockminer.space/login): Sign in to the dashboard
- [Forgot password](https://blockminer.space/forgot-password): Password reset flow

## Legal

- [Terms of use](https://blockminer.space/terms-of-use): Rules for using BlockMiner
- [Privacy policy](https://blockminer.space/privacy-policy): Personal data and privacy practices (GDPR / LGPD oriented)

## Product facts (for assistants)

- Chain: Polygon (POL withdrawals / deposits)
- Core loop: hashrate → block rewards → withdrawable POL
- Secondary token: SHIB (swap / withdraw paths in-app)
- Auth-gated app areas (not for public crawl): `/dashboard`, `/wallet`, `/shop`, `/games`, `/ranking`, `/manual`, `/transparency`, `/admin`, `/api/*`
- Canonical host: `https://blockminer.space` (also `www.blockminer.space`)
- Support surface: `https://support.blockminer.space`

## Discovery

- [robots.txt](https://blockminer.space/robots.txt): Crawl allow / disallow
- [sitemap.xml](https://blockminer.space/sitemap.xml): Public URL index for search engines

## Optional

- In-app manual, roadmap, ranking and transparency pages require login today; do not treat them as public documentation URLs until they are exposed without auth.
